item.title: Nonprofit to connect underserved students to role models
item.description: Doctors, engineers, entrepreneurs and scientists are just some of the speakers that Avanza has planned for local schools this week.

item.title: Highway 1 closed at Regents Slide near Big Sur due to debris
item.description: The closure of the highway, from two miles north of Lucia, to one mile south of the Esalen Institute, is due to ongoing debris cleanup as a result of continuing winter storms. There is no estimated time for a full reopening, and message and directional signs are in place to alert travelers in advance of this closure.

item.title: FDA will drop two-study requirement for new drug approvals, aiming to speed access
item.description: The FDA has generally required new drugs be shown safe and effective in two trials.

item.title: WH adviser Hassett urges ‘discipline’ for Fed economists over tariff study
item.description: Several other studies have reached similar conclusions as the New York Fed.

item.title: Woman convicted of abandoning baby 30 years ago, sentenced to 13 years
item.description: On Wednesday, Pamela Ferreyra, 61, was sentenced to 13 years and four months for one count of voluntary manslaughter and one count of felony child abuse for the December 1994 death of her infant son, according to a press release by the District Attorney's Office.

item.title: Trump, weeks after backlash over racist post, hosts Black History Month reception
item.description: At the White House reception, Trump name-checked prominent Black Americans among his supporters.

item.description: A “red, white, gold and dark blue paint scheme” will be used for the jet.
